title: Goodreads daily reading + highlights

portable_to: Hermes Agent cron in no-agent mode
system cron or launchd after adapting local paths

inputs: annotated-book discovery and post-write detail metadata
outputs: every current title as a bullet

content_types.notes: written text attached to a highlight
content_types.social_comments: separate Goodreads social feature; excluded from this job

risk.confirmation: standing approval limited to idempotently making every discovered annotated book visible before post-write diff/verification

verification: shelf parsed count equals declared count and every title is non-null
every discovered annotated book receives the idempotent visible=true write before detail diffing
every annotated book detail is inspected after the write
post-write visible count equals annotation count
secrets_policy: session cookies and CSRF remain local; public output is counts/titles only

output_format.activity_rule: split Highlights and Notes into separate lines; list affected books and exact counts

limitations: The actual collector script and account session are private, so this is a contract and output template, not a one-command install.
Goodreads can expose additional imported/private rows only after the idempotent visible=true write; never suppress the sweep from pre-write count equality.
Social comments are not attached notes and are intentionally excluded.
Publicizing highlights and attached notes is an account write and requires explicit standing approval.

requires: a Goodreads session cookie stored outside the repo
the private collector script or your own replacement
a local state directory with atomic writes
an explicit decision on highlight/note publicizing
